source.basis: Quoted evidence supports the claim; its interpretation still needs current-source checks.

text: After base folder creation, Exchange reads existing flags, adjusts Trash from the configured path, optionally adds Offline and writes the combined flags once. The offline preference affects this new-folder route; a false value does not explicitly clear an existing Offline bit. There is no Trash/Junk exclusion in the checked block. This flag state does not prove messages were downloaded. No folder or offline test ran.
title: Exchange new-folder flags combine trash selection with offline preference
